# Security

Claude Account Switcher handles Claude Code login tokens, so security reports come first.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report it privately through [GitHub security advisories](https://github.com/michaelcummingsofficial/claude-code-login-switcher/security/advisories/new). Don't open a public issue.

Include the extension version, your operating system and its version, and the steps to reproduce.

## In scope

- Token material reaching a file, a log, an error message, or another process's view of the command line
- Tokens written to the wrong Keychain item, file, or secret
- Anything that loses, corrupts, or mixes up a saved account's tokens
